info.title: Space Store generic Docker catalogue and runtime API
info.description: DESIGN ONLY: v3 contract, not implemented or deployed. Existing v2 endpoints remain unchanged. Published app files are verified data, never client-provided Docker arguments.

get.summary: Read fixed engine capabilities, profiles and grants

post.summary: Register an HTTPS source and pinned public key without granting container privileges
Queue refresh of all enabled sources

get.summary: Read verified applications with explicit blockers
Read application details; sourceId required when ambiguous
Read immutable releases ordered by releaseNumber
Read exact verified manifest and current policy result

post.summary: Validate a manifest without Docker execution, signing or publication
post.description: Hash the original request-body bytes. Return normalizedManifest separately; never describe a reserialized body hash as the original manifest hash. Body limit 1 MiB.

post.summary: Resolve immutable images read-only using allowed registries
Create a RAM-only secret set bound to user and immutable release
post.description: Maximum body 16 KiB, TTL 900 seconds, user/session/release binding. RAM only; logout/restart/expiry invalidate the handle. No secret readback or request logging.

post.summary: Create an immutable generic application operation plan
post.description: Only declared non-secret parameter values are accepted. Bind source/app/release and original manifest hash; private secrets are supplied during execution by a RAM-only handle. Foreign or undeclared volumes/ports/permissions are rejected.

get.summary: Read an existing plan without secret values

post.summary: Idempotently enqueue a reviewed immutable plan
Idempotently enqueue all ordered plans or reject the entire batch

get.summary: Read persistent job state and actual stage
Read persistent state for one job

post.summary: Recheck retained resources and create a new plan

get.summary: Read owned instances and exact release identities
Read an owned instance without native credentials

post.summary: Recheck owned identities without adopting foreign resources

get.summary: Read bounded redacted logs of a verified owned service
Read snapshot integrity and software binding
Authenticated SSE using Authorization header; no credentials in URL

200.description: Persistent job updates; event id supports readback. No fabricated percentage.

get.summary: Download a verified private snapshot with normal administrator authorization

storeAdmin.description: Existing normal store administrator session; no SSH identity substitution.

ValidateInput.description: The request body is the exact raw UTF-8 application manifest, not a JSON wrapper. Duplicate and invalid fields are reported as validation errors.

BadRequest.description: Malformed or duplicate-key JSON / unknown request field

Forbidden.description: Administrator rights or fixed profile grant missing

NotFound.description: Requested immutable resource does not exist

Conflict.description: Stale plan, identity/port/storage change, ambiguous source or idempotency conflict

TooLarge.description: Body, artifact or configured limit exceeded

InvalidManifest.description: Unsupported capability or invalid semantic reference
